title: Workflow and activity declaration conventions (PostHog Temporal)
answers: How do I declare a Temporal workflow here?
How are activity inputs and context passed?
How should I log in workflows and activities?
body:
- Workflows subclass `posthog/temporal/common/base.py:PostHogWorkflow`, use `@workflow.defn(name="kebab-name")` (e.g. `alerts/workflows.py:CheckAlertWorkflow`); the name is what `manage.py execute_temporal_workflow` takes.
- Each has static `parse_inputs(list[str])` that JSON-decodes into an inputs dataclass.
- Django/non-deterministic imports go under `workflow.unsafe.imports_passed_through()`.
- Activities are `@activity.defn` async functions taking ONE inputs dataclass (often `@frozen` from `posthog.dataclasses`), e.g. `alerts/activities.py:prepare_alert`. Context (team_id, ids) travels in the inputs.
- Ambient context: `common/activity_context.py` (`current_workflow_id`, `current_activity_attempt`, ...) returns None/1 outside an activity.
- `common/scoped.py:scoped_temporal` replaces `posthoganalytics.scoped` on async activities.
- Logging: never pass keyword fields to `activity.logger`/`workflow.logger` (TypeError); use `extra={}` in workflows and the structlog logger in activities (`posthog/temporal/AGENTS.md`).
- Adding commands to an existing workflow needs `workflow.patched` (`.claude/rules/temporal-workflow-versioning.md`).
applies: Code under posthog/temporal and product backend/temporal packages.
says: How do I create a new asynchronous workflow for background tasks
Alert checking jobs execute but produce no useful diagnostic logs
Scheduled alert tasks fail without clear error context in logs
Activity context like team identity missing from async task outputs
Different teams' scheduled tasks sometimes interfere with each other

Activities are @activity.defn async functions taking a single inputs dataclass (often @frozen), with context (team_id, ids) traveling in the inputs; ambient context is accessed via current_workflow_id and current_activity_attempt from common/activity_context.py. Django/non-deterministic imports must go under workflow.unsafe.imports_passed_through(); never pass keyword fields to activity.logger or workflow.logger (use extra={} in workflows, structlog in activities). Adding commands to an existing workflow requires workflow.patched decoration (see .claude/rules/temporal-workflow-versioning.md). This convention applies to code under posthog/temporal and product backend/temporal packages.
